basic_details.job_title: ECHS Recruitment 2026 - Apply Offline for Off-in-Charge Polyclinic/ Driver Posts
basic_details.short_information: Ex Servicemen Contributory Health Scheme (ECHS) Recruitment 2026 notification has been released by the Ex Servicemen Contributory Health Scheme (ECHS) on its official website for the recruitment of 2 Off-in-Charge Polyclinic and Driver posts. This recruitment offers an excellent opportunity for eligible candidates seeking contractual government jobs in the healthcare sector.

qualification.education_qualification: Graduate with minimum 5 years work experience in Health Care Institutions or Managerial positions, 8th pass, Class-I MT Driver (Armed Forces) with 5 years work experience and civil driving licence
qualification.details: Off-in-Charge Polyclinic: Graduate with a minimum of 05 (five) years of work experience in Health Care Institutions or Managerial positions. Driver: Education: 8th pass. Must be a Class-I MT Driver (Armed Forces) with 05 years of work experience. Must possess a civil driving license.

salary_details.details: Off-in-Charge Polyclinic: Rs. 95000 Per Month Driver: Rs. 25600 Per Month

how_to_apply: Candidates who wish to apply for ECHS Various Posts Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below.
Read the official notification carefully before applying.
Download the application form from the official website: www.echs.gov.in.
Fill the application form carefully with correct information.
Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates.
Check all details carefully before submission.
Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed.
Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 18-08-2026.
Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for ECHS Various Posts Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: www.echs.gov.in. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 18-08-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the ECHS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date for the receipt of applications for the ECHS Recruitment 2026 is 18th August 2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well in advance of this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the ECHS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies announced for the ECHS Recruitment 2026, for the posts of Off-in-Charge Polyclinic and Driver.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for the ECHS Recruitment 2026 is offline. Candidates need to download the application form and submit it via post.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Off-in-Charge Polyclinic post?
faq.answer: The salary offered for the Off-in-Charge Polyclinic post is Rs. 95,000 per month.

faq.question: Q5. What are the educational qualifications required for the Driver post?
faq.answer: For the Driver post, candidates must have passed 8th grade, be a Class-I MT Driver (Armed Forces) with 5 years of experience, and possess a civil driving license.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for ECHS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for the ECHS Recruitment 2026.

faq.question: Q7. What is the interview date for the ECHS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The interview date for the ECHS Recruitment 2026 is scheduled for 21st August 2026.

faq.question: Q8. What is the official website of ECHS?
faq.answer: The official website of Ex Servicemen Contributory Health Scheme (ECHS) is www.echs.gov.in.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process for the ECHS Recruitment 2026 will be based on an Interview.

faq.question: Q10. What is the work experience required for the Off-in-Charge Polyclinic post?
faq.answer: Candidates applying for the Off-in-Charge Polyclinic post must have a minimum of 5 years of work experience in Health Care Institutions or Managerial positions.
